Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_EnableMod_tool: Creates a persistent sleeping survivor when a player disconnects. Disabling this removes existing offline survivors.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_EnableLoot_too: Allows players to search an offline survivor through the custom Search menu.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_LootMaxItems_t: Maximum number of eligible items a player may take during one search.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_LootCooldownHo: Real-world hours a player must wait after a successful search. Set to 0 to disable the cooldown.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_LootDistance_t: Maximum distance from the offline survivor required to open and complete a search.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_BedRadius_tool: Searches for a bed near the logout tile. Set to 0 to use only a bed on the same tile.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_SofaRadius_too: If no bed is found, searches for a large sofa near the logout tile. Set to 0 to use only a sofa on the same tile.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_DespawnHours_t: Real-world minutes before an offline survivor is removed. Decimal values are supported: 0.1 equals 6 seconds. Set to 0 to keep it until its owner reconnects.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_AllowZombieDea: Disabled by default. Nearby zombies walk to a sleeping offline survivor and feed on the body using the game's own corpse-eating behaviour. After a few seconds of being devoured the player dies, leaving a normal lootable corpse, and the death is applied when that player reconnects.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_ZombieKillMinu: Real minutes zombies must feed on a sleeping survivor before that player dies. Decimals are allowed: 0.5 is thirty seconds. Only used when 'Zombies Can Kill Sleeping Survivors' is enabled.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_AllowBodyDragg: Allows players to use the native corpse-dragging animation to move a sleeping survivor. The survivor reconnects at the final location.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_BlockAdminOffl: Enabled by default. Administrators do not leave an offline survivor when they disconnect. Disable only if administrators should follow the same rule as regular players.
Sandbox_OfflineSurvivorV2_AdminCleanupRa: Admin-only right-click cleanup. Radius 1-50, same floor, loaded squares only. Removes corpse loot permanently; removing a sleeping proxy does not kill its owner.
